seo.title: Roles of Healthcare Staffing Agencies in Canada’s Healthcare
seo.description: Discover the roles of healthcare staffing agencies like Goodwill Staffing play in bridging the gap between healthcare facilities and skilled professionals.

html:
There are current and emerging labor demands in the Canadian health care industry. In the fast-paced world of healthcare, the demand for qualified professionals continues to grow. This leads to burnouts in existing medical professionals, absences and turnover. This affects patients as well, as they now experience long wait times and emergency room closures. In 2023, A national survey showed that more than one in five Canadians — an estimated 6.5 million people — do not have a family physician or nurse practitioner they see regularly, according to a national survey (National Library of Medicine). This is where healthcare staffing agencies step in. We serve as a crucial staffing solution between healthcare facilities and the professionals who keep them running.

Here’s a list of ways we support the healthcare industry in Canada:

1. Address workforce shortages

 The healthcare industry faces significant staffing shortages, especially in areas like nursing, allied health, and specialized care. Staffing agencies help fill these gaps quickly, ensuring that patient care is never compromised.

2. Offer flexibility for facilities and professionals

Whether a facility needs temporary staff to cover a surge in patients or a professional is seeking flexible work arrangements, staffing agencies offer tailored solutions that meet both parties’ needs.

3. Streamline hiring process

Recruiting qualified healthcare professionals can be time-consuming and costly. Staffing agencies streamline the process by pre-screening candidates, verifying credentials, and matching them to the right opportunities.

4. Coordinate travel needs of healthcare professionals

For those working in the healthcare field, partnering with a staffing agency can open doors to a range of opportunities and support the travel preparation process and accommodations they may need for their work assignments. Healthcare professionals also benefit from gaining experience in various settings, from hospitals to home healthcare.

5. Save costs and time for healthcare facilities

Healthcare facilities also reap significant benefits from partnering with staffing agencies. Facilities save costs by reducing the time and resources spent on recruitment and onboarding. We also make the process faster by providing quick access to a Talent Pool so they can quickly connect with qualified candidates for both temporary and permanent roles.

We are here to help

As the healthcare industry continues to evolve, the role of staffing agencies will become even more vital. By connecting skilled professionals with the facilities that need them, these agencies ensure that healthcare systems remain resilient and responsive to the needs of patients and communities alike.

If you’re a healthcare professional looking for your next opportunity or a facility in need of top talent, reach out to Goodwill Staffing and Recruitment today. A great place to start is to check out our Job Board, where we post job openings frequently.
